messages:
maya: Heads up — we're seeing a p99 jump in eu-west hosted API since ~13:10 UTC, p99 went from ~220ms -> ~1.6s across multiple models. :eyes:
jon: saw the alert too, thanks. Any obvious fanout or deploys?
samir: no deploys at 13:10 in infra. I can pull runtime stats.
perf-bot: snapshot: region=eu-west-1, window=13:05-13:20, p50=180ms, p95=360ms, p99=1.62s, queue_depth_avg=12, queue_depth_p95=68, outgoing_kv_evictions/sec=420
lee: queue_depth_p95=68 is worrying. Any tenant hotspots?
maya: looking at request traces — a cluster of long-context jobs from tenant-47, a few > 8k tokens, lots of single-request heavy sequences. Might be KV churn.
jon: can you paste the runtime probe? that kv eviction/sec seems high.
samir: running quick probe: ```
$ curl -s http://runtime-internal/eu-west/queues | jq '.["shard-7"]'
{"queue_depth":54,"inflight_batches":3,"batching_latency_ms":1400,"kernel_selector":"fallback_scalar_v2","kv_cache_hits":0.12,"kv_cache_size_mb":12000}
```
lee: kernel_selector switched to fallback_scalar_v2 at ~13:03 (auto-fallback on kernel miss after quantized path timed out). That will blow up per-token time for long contexts.
maya: where did the fallback come from? recent operator flip or autoswitch due to sampler?
samir: build v2.14.0 changed kernel affinity heuristics yesterday (coalesce window bumped from 6ms->20ms). I suspect larger coalesce made batch patterns different -> kernel selector mispredicted and hit fallback more.
jon: that matches: fallback_scalar_v2 has much worse throughput for long kv-heavy requests, and with tenant-47's long sequences we see queueing.
lee: mitigation idea: 1) temp rate-cap tenant-47, 2) force kernel affinity rollback to old selector on shard-7, 3) reduce coalescing window for short-seqs. Thoughts?
maya: do 1 + 2 now. I'll file the cap. @samir can you push kernel toggle?
samir: rolling kernel toggle on shard-7 -> old_selector (fast_kv_path) now. will watch.
perf-bot: action: tenant cap applied tenant-47 -> 10 rps at 13:21 UTC by maya
perf-bot: kernel toggle completed on shard-7 -> fast_kv_path at 13:22 UTC by samir
lee: seeing p99 drop back to ~280ms within 60s on shard-7. queues draining. :thumbsup:
maya: good. follow-ups: revert coalesce window change in v2.14.1, add kernel-selector unit test for long-context heuristic, and add KV eviction alarm threshold to avoid silent thrash. I'll make a follow-up ticket.
jon: add a short-term autoswitch guard: don't fallback_scalar_v2 for sequences > 4096 tokens.
samir: noted. I'll open change and add perf regression test in CI that simulates tenant-like long sequences.
maya: thanks all. closing thread once we have the postmortem and PRs linked. :white_check_mark:
